name: Pip Wreck
description: Act 2, chapter `engram`, optional (STORY.md §16): the `pip-wreck` mission on Pip. A small rough rust-coloured moon. Kindred's scout lander lies in a small crater to the north-west (`scout-wreck`, a wreck); the scouts stranded since before Landfall are "held for their safety" in Engram's pen to the north-east: a levelled floor inside a low ring wall with a gap to the south-west (`engram-pen`). A sharp ridge crosses the south-east (`ridge`, on its crest). No life, no packs (open spawn, 30 min grace). Hooks: free the scouts by talk (`engram` ≥ 1) or by force (`engram` −3). Engram is a faction here (team 3, neutral): the pen's masts and power (no turrets, so freed scouts are safe), 3 Tanks guarding the pen (pen-guard: beaten sets pen-guard-down, the force path), 2 Scout drones patrolling. The scouts are spawned as ours (4 Field Engineers) when freed. Expedition: 700 alloys, 2 drones, 4 Rovers, 3 Tanks, 2 Lancers (enough to break the pen).
